prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was reminiscing about that 2025 trip when we started in Beijing and ended up in Shanghai—felt like we were constantly on the move.
And before we left, we did the whole tourist thing in Beijing too—someone in the group was listing out attractions like it was a checklist.
For the train part, I remember the ticket my coworker grabbed was for D321, and it was on 2025-03-06.
It was booked under Feng Jie, and I’m pretty sure the seat was Second Class—nothing fancy, but it was fine.
Oh, and later on that spring, John Smith handled the Great Wall Badaling tickets—morning slot on 2025-04-27, and he got 5 tickets for the group.
